    op: auth.authenticate
    params:

    depends_on:

    op: data.fetch
    params:
      source: "{{agent_config.sources[0]}}"
      auth_token: "{{auth_token}}"
    depends_on:
      - authenticate_agent
    output: source_1_data

  - id: fetch_source_2
    op: data.fetch
    params:
      source: "{{agent_config.sources[1]}}"
      auth_token: "{{auth_token}}"
    depends_on:
      - authenticate_agent
    output: source_2_data

  - id: fetch_source_3
    op: data.fetch
    params:
      source: "{{agent_config.sources[2]}}"
      auth_token: "{{auth_token}}"
    depends_on:
      - authenticate_agent
    output: source_3_data

  - id: classify_combined_context
    op: classify
    params:
      inputs:
        - "{{source_1_data}}"
        - "{{source_2_data}}"
        - "{{source_3_data}}"
      taxonomy: "{{agent_config.classification_taxonomy}}"
    depends_on:
      - fetch_source_1
      - fetch_source_2
      - fetch_source_3
    output: classification_result

  - id: route_execution

    params:
      classification: "{{classification_result}}"
      routing_rules: "{{agent_config.routing_rules}}"
      data:

        source_2: "{{source_2_data}}"
        source_3: "{{source_3_data}}"
    depends_on:
      - classify_combined_context
    output: routed_data

    params:
      input: "{{routed_data}}"
      target_format: "{{agent_config.storage_format}}"
    depends_on:

    output: transformed_data

  - id: validate_data

    params:
      data: "{{transformed_data}}"
      schema: "{{agent_config.validation_schema}}"
    depends_on:

    output: validation_result

      validation: "{{validation_result}}"

    output: audit_record

workflow_id: forum_thread_escalation
steps:
  - id: fetch_thread_and_report
    op: fetch
    params:
      source: forum_database
      entity: reported_thread
      include:
        - thread_content
        - report_metadata
    output: thread_data

  - id: validate_report
    op: validate
    params:
      input: "{{ thread_data }}"
      schema: report_schema
    output: validation_result

  - id: classify_severity
    op: classify
    params:
      input: "{{ thread_data }}"
      rule: escalation_rule
      severity_levels:
        - standard
        - severe
    output: severity_classification

  - id: route_thread
    op: conditional_route
    params:
      condition: "{{ severity_classification.level == 'severe' }}"
      on_true:
        destination: senior_escalation_queue
        label: escalated
      on_false:
        destination: standard_moderation_queue
        label: standard
    output: routing_decision

  - id: notify_senior_moderator
    op: notify
    params:
      condition: "{{ routing_decision.label == 'escalated' }}"
      channel: senior_moderator_notification
      message: "A forum thread has been escalated for review."
      payload:
        thread_id: "{{ thread_data.thread_id }}"
        report_id: "{{ thread_data.report_metadata.report_id }}"
        severity: "{{ severity_classification.level }}"
        reason: "{{ severity_classification.reason }}"

  - id: log_moderation_decision
    op: log
    params:
      destination: audit_log
      entry:
        thread_id: "{{ thread_data.thread_id }}"
        report_id: "{{ thread_data.report_metadata.report_id }}"
        severity: "{{ severity_classification.level }}"
        routing: "{{ routing_decision.label }}"
        destination_queue: "{{ routing_decision.destination }}"
        timestamp: "{{ now() }}"

steps:
  - id: search_product
    op: catalog/search
    params:
      query: "{{trigger.search_query}}"
      filters: "{{trigger.search_filters}}"
    output: search_results

  - id: authenticate_shopper
    op: auth/authenticate
    params:
      token: "{{trigger.auth_token}}"
      session_id: "{{trigger.session_id}}"
    output: shopper_identity

  - id: validate_cart
    op: schema/validate
    params:
      schema: checkout_schema
      data:
        shopper_id: "{{authenticate_shopper.shopper_identity.user_id}}"
        cart_items: "{{trigger.cart_items}}"
        shipping_address: "{{trigger.shipping_address}}"
        payment_method: "{{trigger.payment_method}}"
    depends_on:
      - authenticate_shopper
    output: validated_cart

  - id: process_order
    op: order/process
    params:
      shopper_id: "{{authenticate_shopper.shopper_identity.user_id}}"
      validated_cart: "{{validate_cart.validated_cart}}"
      payment_method: "{{trigger.payment_method}}"
    depends_on:
      - authenticate_shopper
      - validate_cart
    output: order_result

  - id: fulfill_order
    op: subworkflow/invoke
    params:
      workflow_id: fulfillment_subworkflow
      input:
        order_id: "{{process_order.order_result.order_id}}"
        items: "{{validate_cart.validated_cart.items}}"
        shipping_address: "{{trigger.shipping_address}}"
    depends_on:
      - process_order
    output: fulfillment_result

  - id: extract_fulfillment_status
    op: transform/extract
    params:
      source: "{{fulfill_order.fulfillment_result}}"
      fields:
        - status
        - tracking_number
        - estimated_delivery
    depends_on:
      - fulfill_order
    output: fulfillment_status

  - id: notify_customer
    op: notification/send
    params:
      recipient: "{{authenticate_shopper.shopper_identity.email}}"
      template: order_fulfilled
      data:
        order_id: "{{process_order.order_result.order_id}}"
        status: "{{extract_fulfillment_status.fulfillment_status.status}}"
        tracking_number: "{{extract_fulfillment_status.fulfillment_status.tracking_number}}"
        estimated_delivery: "{{extract_fulfillment_status.fulfillment_status.estimated_delivery}}"
    depends_on:
      - extract_fulfillment_status
    output: notification_result

  - id: log_purchase_audit
    op: audit/log
    params:
      event_type: purchase_completed
      shopper_id: "{{authenticate_shopper.shopper_identity.user_id}}"
      order_id: "{{process_order.order_result.order_id}}"
      fulfillment_status: "{{extract_fulfillment_status.fulfillment_status.status}}"
      notification_status: "{{notify_customer.notification_result.status}}"
      timestamp: "{{$now}}"
    depends_on:
      - notify_customer
    on_failure: retry
    always_run: true
    output: audit_log_entry
